question: Neil Nongkynrih is a concert pianist and founder of _______ from India.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Shillong Chamber Choir.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Neil Nongkynrih** is a concert pianist and founder of **Shillong Chamber Choir** from India. 
 
• Shillong Chamber Choir is an Indian chamber choir based in Shillong, Meghalaya that was founded in 2001.
 
• **In 2010,** he led his choir to win India's Got Talent.
 
• In 2015, he was awarded the **Padma Shri,** India's fourth-highest civilian award.
 
• The Choir's rendition of** "Vande Mataram"** was played during the telecast of Chandrayaan II's launch.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Neil Nongkynrih was an Indian musical performance pianist and conductor. 
 
• Nongkynrih learned music at Trinity College and Guildhall School of Music in London. 
 
• He represent in many concert as a concert pianist in United Kingdom.
